4.0.0.en: Now requires Homey firmware 12.11.0 or newer. Added 8 new SMS providers (Africa's Talking, Burst SMS, ClickSend, Clockwork SMS, Plivo, Telnyx, TextMagic, Vonage), plus httpSMS: send SMS for free through your own old Android phone's SIM instead of a paid provider. sms77 is now called Seven; existing settings keep working unchanged. Settings page redesigned: providers listed alphabetically, clearer field labels (e.g. Twilio's Account SID/Auth Token) and setup hints, error messages no longer cut short, and the app is now fully translated into all 13 Homey languages (previously English/German/Dutch only). Flow card now shows the number and message in the flow editor.

3.0.0.en: Rewrite to SDK3. Fix HTTP(S) timeout. Improved settings page. Added gatewayapi.

3.0.1.en: Http(s) timeout doubled. App logger improved.

3.0.2.en: Fix all services that use an API ID.

2.3.0.en: Fixed BulkSMS. Added SendInBlue.com. Added FreeMobile.fr. Added readme.txt
